name: multi-stop-route-and-distance-optimizer
title: Multi-Stop Route, Geocoder & 2-Opt TSP Distance Optimizer
description: Geocodes street addresses or lat/lng coordinates via OpenStreetMap Nominatim, builds road-adjusted Haversine distance matrices, solves Nearest-Neighbor + 2-Opt Travelling Salesperson (TSP) route optimization within shift time windows, and generates multi-stop Google Maps navigation URLs.
